svg.text: Each Token Gets Its Own Q, K, V Vectors
Self-attention: Every token produces a Query, Key, and Value — but uses them differently
How attention USES these vectors (computing output for "fox"):
Each token computes its own q, k, v vectors.
But to compute output for token i:
• Use qi (query from token i only)
• Compare against kj for ALL tokens j
• Weighted sum of vj for ALL tokens j
Q = "What am I looking for?" (the question)
Formula for output at position i:
